endsBefore: Nothing to fill: the series ends before the next cell
enterStop: With one cell selected, enter a stop value
needsNumber: {cell} must hold a number or date to start from
nothingToFillStart: Nothing to fill: start each row or column with values to continue, followed by empty cells
protected: This sheet is protected. Unprotect it to fill a series
selectCells: Select the cells to fill, starting with the values to continue
stepNonZero: With one cell selected, enter a step other than 0 so the series can reach the stop value
stopAsDate: Enter the stop value as a date, like 2024-12-31
title: Fill series
